target.cpu: Main-observed Ryzen 5 5600X, family 25 decimal (19h), model 33 decimal (21h), stepping 0; AVX2/FMA/F16C, no AVX-512; 6 cores/12 threads/32 MiB L3.
target.amd_fact_limit: Official product specs confirm Vermeer, core/thread and L3 facts. Family/model/stepping are local observations. AMD guide 56665 is EPYC 7003-branded Family 19h guidance, not Model 21h timings/PMU. Do not apply PPR 55898 (Models 00h-0Fh) to Model 21h.
target.compiler: Packet native-build context: oneAPI icpx/icx 2026.2, SHA256 59eaaf55744c7290fb870cd12049ec11877b5224e333cba33270b433bdb73213. A future comparison must pin the actual frozen compiler, flags and target. llvm-mca's znver3 model/version is a separate input.
target.pmu: Main probe exits 1 at perf_event_paranoid=4. No PMU/IBS, port saturation or physical traffic evidence. Kernel docs say unprivileged CPU event access is denied at paranoid >=1 without CAP_PERFMON.
target.evidence_limit: Disassembly and llvm-mca are static discriminators, not throughput, cache, frequency, saturation or model qualification. Keep clean repeated wall-time comparison separate.

corrections.fact: 2-byte half + 4-byte eight-nibble scale + 128-byte combined index/sign storage for 256 weights = 134 bytes; sign/index separation does not save the existing 128 bytes.
2*62*128=15872 per adjacent pair, below signed-int16 saturation.
8*4*62*128*31=7872512 is the max absolute sum per int32 lane across eight chunks, not across all vector lanes.
corrections.status: clarify wording; source comment calls it a lane bound

corrections.fact: Negative sign applies byte two's-complement negation; -128 wraps to 0x80, not mathematical +128. Native parity is not mathematical signed-dot exactness.
corrections.status: state caveat and retain corner case in parity checks

corrections.fact: Source already visits gate then up per chunk. Reorder/staging or nibble scheduling matters only if exact emitted code exposes a removable dependency. 295 instructions/no YMM stack is static, not proof of an unbound resource.
+4 bytes/block: 134 to 138, +2.99%; trades scale nibble decoding for loads/cache footprint. Main-supplied screen: 0/6 improving cells over 12 processes/108 batches.
corrections.status: not adopted; no repeat without new evidence
